data.name: label13.Text
data.value:
Set step by step commands to develop pick-up and remove scripts.
Useful commands: G91 = relative mode G53 G90 = absolut machine coordinates G1 F100 = slow speed See https://linuxcnc.org/docs/html/gcode.html for further information.
Variables: #TOGO = gripper open #TOGC = gripper close #TOAX, #TOAY, #TOAZ = pen change coordinates actual pen #TOLX, #TOLY, #TOLZ = pen change coordinates last pen
